text: Torpedo hole. Discovered by government divers in the Maine. A New York front page, two days after the battleship Maine blew up in Havana.
Divers found an eight inch hole in her plates, the paper said. Proof of a torpedo. Spanish treachery.
But look lower, on the same front page. Divers will go down today at the wreck.
The Navy's divers reached Havana two days later. The paper never named a source.
Ten weeks later, America and Spain were at war. In March, the Navy's court had found a mine, but no evidence of who.
In nineteen seventy six, a Navy study said: there is no evidence that a mine destroyed the Maine. So who found that torpedo hole?
